content: Řɛahd jar Dawud d Yunatan
Dawud yarweř zi Nayut tenni ɣar Rama uca yusa-dd ɣar Yunatan, inna: “Min ggiɣ necc? Man ljarima inu d ddenb i d as ggiɣ i babac, aqa netta ixs ad zzayi ikkes tudart?”

Inna as Yunatan: “War xas nessiweř! Cek war tᵉttmettid ca. Xzar baba war ittegg walu, uřa d ict n řḥajjet d tameqqrant niɣ tameẓyant, břa ma i d ayi tt ɣa issargeb. Mayemmi baba zzayi i ɣa issnuffar tamesřact-a? Aya war izemmar.”

Xenni ijjuǧ as Dawud twařa nneɣnit, inna: “Babac issen nican, aqa ufiɣ řxaḍar di tiṭṭawin nnec. X uya inna: ‘War ttejji ad issen Yunatan man aya, ḥima war ikessi s wemnus!’ X uya, s tidett am iddar SIDI u am ddareɣ necc, aqa din jar ayi d řmewt mɣir ijj n uṣurif waha!”
Yunatan inna i Dawud: “Min iǧan deg wuř nnec, necc ad ac t ggeɣ.”
Dawud yarra-dd x Yunatan: “Xzar, tiwecca ad ibedd uyur uca ittxeṣṣa ayi ad qqimeɣ ɣar ṭṭabřa ak-d ujeǧid ad cceɣ. Ewc ayi ttesřiḥ ḥima ad uyureɣ maḥend ad nuffareɣ deg iyyar ař tameddit wiss třata.
Mařa yarzu xafi babac, ifqed ayi, xenni ini: ‘Dawud iḥeccem ayi s waṭṭas ḥima izemmar ad iraḥ ɣar tendint nnes deɣya, ɣar Bayt-Laḥm, minzi dinni i ɣa tiři tɣarṣt n useggʷas i marra řaǧ.’
Mařa netta xenni inna: ‘Mliḥ!’, ad yiři řehna i umsexxar nnec, maca mařa yarɣa ufugem nnes, xenni ad tessned, aqa netta igga di řbař nnes ad d ayi igg řɣar.
Egg s tmexsiwt icewwaren ak-d umsexxar nnec, minzi tessidfed amsexxar nnec akidek deg ijj n řɛahd n SIDI. Maca mařa ggiɣ ict n ljarima, neɣ ayi cek. Mayemmi texsed ad ayi tawyed ɣar babac?”
Inna Yunatan: “Aqa man aya iggʷej xak! Minzi waxxa aregbeɣ xas, aqa baba igga di řbař nnes ad dayek igg řɣar, ma xenni necc war d ac t qqareɣ?”
Inna Dawud i Yunatan: “Man wen i d ayi dd ɣa yawyen areqqas, mařa iwca ac babac ict n temwarrit teqseḥ?”
Xenni inna Yunatan i Dawud: “As-dd, ejj aneɣ ad neffeɣ barra ɣar yeyyar.” Uca ffɣen nitni s tnayen idsen, ɣar yeyyar barra.

Inna Yunatan i Dawud: “Jjuǧeɣ ɣar SIDI, AREBBI n Israil, mařa necc tiwecca niɣ farwicca ɣar řweqt-a, aqa wtiɣ řeḥsab ammu d wammu zi jjihet n baba, ufiɣ aqa mliḥ i Dawud uca xenni necc war ssekkiɣ ḥed ad ac t yini,

xenni ad igg SIDI ta d ta s Yunatan u ad dayes yarni ɛad. Maca mařa ittɣiř as mliḥ i baba ad dayek igg řɣar, xenni necc ad ac t iniɣ, ad cek jjeɣ ad teffɣed ḥima tzemmared ad tuyured di řehna. SIDI ad yiři akidek am mammec i tuɣa ak-d baba.
Uca xak, war ittiři waha am ddareɣ, war ittiři xenni waha ad ayi tessecned tamexsiwt icewwaren n SIDI ḥima war ttmettiɣ ca,
maca ɛad war tqeṭṭɛed tamexsiwt nnec icewwaren i řebda x taddart inu, uřa xmi ɣa iqḍeɛ SIDI marra řɛedyan n Dawud zeg wudem n temmurt!”
Uca igga Yunatan ijj n řɛahd ak-d taddart n Dawud uca SIDI ittar i-t zeg ufus n řɛedyan n Dawud.
Yunatan ijja Dawud ad ijjaǧ twařa nneɣnit, minzi netta tuɣa ittexs i-t, aqa ittexs i-t am mammec tuɣa ittexs ixef nnes.
Xas uca inna as Yunatan: “Tiwecca d ayur amaynu u nitni war cek ttifen, maɣar řkursi nnec ad iqqim ixwa.
Awarni ɛdun třata n wussan ittxeṣṣa ad tehwid qaɛ, ad truḥed ɣar wemcan mani tuɣa tennuffared deg wass nni di yarzu netta ad cek ineɣ, u qqim ɣar uɣezdis n weẓru n Ha’izil.
Necc ad wteɣ třata n fřitcat zzates axmi xseɣ ad řeqfeɣ tandayt.

Xzar, necc ad ssekkeɣ aḥudri awarni asent, ad as iniɣ: ‘Uyur, arzu x fřitcat!’ Mařa necc ad iniɣ nican i uḥudri: ‘Ḥḍa, fřitcat aqa udsent ɣar uɣezdis-a zi ɣarek!’, xenni awyi tent-i-dd, as-dd, maɣar aqa din řehna i cek u war din walu, s tidett am iddar SIDI!
Maca mařa necc nniɣ i uḥudri: ‘Xẓar, fřitcat aqa aggʷejent xak ɛad ktar!’, xenni aggʷej, maɣar SIDI issekka cek ɣar řaggʷaj.
Uca x wawař i nekkes, necc d cek, aqa SIDI ad yiři d acehhad jar ayi d cek i řebda!”
Issnuffar Dawud ixef nnes barra deg iyyar. Řami dd-yusa uyur amaynu iqqim ujeǧid ɣar ṭṭabřa ḥima ad icc.
Tuɣa ajeǧid iqqim ɣar umensi-ya deg wemcan nnes am mammec tuɣa iqqim ɣar imensiyyen inneɣni, di řkursi i iǧan ɣar řḥiḍ. Yunatan ikkar u Abnir iqqim ɣar uɣezdis n Cawul u řkursi n Dawud iban-dd ixwa.
Deg wass nni Cawul war ini walu, maɣar netta inna deg ixef nnes: “Imsar as ca ařami netta war iǧi d amezdag. Aqa nican netta war iǧi d amezdag.”
Tiwecca nnes, deg wass wiss tnayen awarni i uyur amaynu, umi iqqim řkursi n Dawud ixwa ɛawed, imsar, aqa inna Cawul i mmis Yunatan: “Mayemmi mmis n Yassa war dd-yusi iḍennaḍ d wass-a ɣar umensi?”
Yunatan yarra-dd x Cawul: “Dawud iḥeccem ayi aṭṭas maḥend izemmar ad iraḥ ɣar Bayt-Laḥm.

Netta inna: ‘Ejj ayi ad uyureɣ, maɣar neccin ad negg ict n tɣarṣt n řaǧ nneɣ di tendint. Uma igga xafi ad ḥḍareɣ. Mařa xenni ufiɣ řexxu arḍa di tiṭṭawin nnec, ttzawageɣ, ejj ayi ad uyureɣ ḥima ad ẓareɣ aytma.’ X uya war dd-yusi Dawud ɣar ṭṭabřa n ujeǧid.”

Xenni yareɣ uxeyyeq n Cawul x Yunatan, inna as: “Cek, mmis n temɣart iɣennan ifarɣen, necc ssneɣ mliḥ, aqa cek tixḍared aɣezdis n mmis n Yassa. D man aya d řefḍiḥet i cek d řefḍiḥet i tuɛɛaryent n yemmac!
Minzi marra ussan min ɣa yekk mmis n Yassa iddar x temmurt, war tbeddid cek uřa d tageldit nnec. Xenni řexxu, sekk ijjen, awyi t-i-dd ɣari, maɣar netta d mmis n řmewt.”
Yarra-dd Yunatan x babas Cawul, inna as: “Mayemmi ittxeṣṣa ad ittwaneɣ netta? Min igga?”
Xenni iḥejjar i-t Cawul s lansa nnes, ḥima ad t iřqef. Ammu i issen Yunatan, aqa babas tuɣa igga di řbař nnes ad ineɣ Dawud.
Ikkar Yunatan x ṭṭabřa umi yarɣa uxeyyeq nnes, war icci aɣrum deg wass wiss tnayen n uyur amaynu, maɣar netta tuɣa ikessi s wemnus i Dawud, minzi babas tuɣa issbehdeř i-t ammu.
Tiwecca nnes ɣar tuffut, imsar aqa Yunatan yuyur barra deg iyyar, di řweqt i igga amsagar ak-d Dawud u tuɣa akides ijj n uḥudri d ameẓyan.
Netta inna i uḥudri: “Uyur, arzu x fřitcat nni ɣa wteɣ.” Aḥudri yuzzeř u netta iwta ict n fřitca tekka sennej nnes.
Umi dd-yiweḍ uḥudri ɣar wemcan mani teǧa fřitca, iřaɣa-dd Yunatan awarni i uḥudri, inna: “Ma war tewḍi fřitca zzayek aɣirin ɛad?”
Iřaɣa Yunatan ɛawed i uḥudri “Deɣya, azzeř, war ttbeddi!” Aḥudri i iǧan ak-d Yunatan issmun fřitca uca iɛqeb ɣar bab nnes.
Aḥudri war issin walu. Mɣir Yunatan d Dawud ssnen x tmesřact jar asen.
Xenni iwca Yunatan řeqcuɛ n řesnaḥ nnes i uḥudri i tuɣa ɣares iǧan, inna as: “Uyur, arr i-ten ɣar tendint!”
Umi yuyur uḥudri, ikkar Dawud zeg uɣezdis n ljanub, iwḍa s uɣembub nnes ɣar temmurt uca yuḍar třata n twařawin. Nitni ssudmen ayawya, run s tnayen idsen ařami Dawud yarni dayes.
U Yunatan inna i Dawud: “Uyur di řehna. Aqa nejjuǧ s tnayen idneɣ s Yisem n SIDI, nenna: ‘Ad yiři SIDI d acehhad jar ayi d cek, jar zzariɛet inu d zzariɛet nnec i řebda!’”
